baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb ٱقْتَحَمَ and the object ٱلْعَقَبَةَ join forceful entry to a steep obstruction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe or frightening undertaking is spatialized as a rising, jutting pass: crossing requires entering the danger rather than remaining before it.

activation_trace.role: Entering severe danger without prior security supplies the forceful launch into the mechanism.
The steep pass and jutting rock give that dangerous entry its resistant upward terrain.

changed_reading.before: He simply failed to get past an unspecified obstacle.
changed_reading.after: He did not launch into the steep, dangerous ascent; the failure occurs before committed entry, not only at the summit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus words can organize danger around advance, heel, and recoil.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pass is a commitment threshold: it is an affair not everyone undertakes, and its opposite motion is retreat on the heel. The negation therefore marks refusal to enter a course whose first step forecloses easy recoil.

activation_trace.role: A perilous great affair not ridden by everyone makes entry a selective commitment.
Turning back on the heel supplies the live reverse motion against which committed advance is measured.
The heel and rear trace locate the abandoned path immediately behind the would-be crosser.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports inability to surmount difficult ground.
changed_reading.after: The clause can instead expose recoil at a no-easy-return threshold: he never converts approach into committed advance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْعَقَبَةَ also carries aftermath, follow-up claim, and retained liability, while ٱقْتَحَمَ can enter dangers and unwanted consequences.
baseline_models.mechanism: The obstacle is temporal and juridical as well as spatial. To act is to enter what the act leaves behind—its outcome, claim, or liability—whereas non-crossing is avoidance of that accountable aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Road dangers and unwanted consequences of dispute let forceful entry extend from terrain into costly aftermath.
The end and result turn the pass into what follows from an action.
Substitution and retained liability give the aftermath a concrete claim that remains to be discharged.

changed_reading.before: He did not cross a piece of difficult terrain.
changed_reading.after: He did not enter the accountable consequence of action—the pass is also the claim and aftermath one accepts rather than evades.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A focus branch of ٱقْتَحَمَ names a drought-year that drives people into settlement, while a branch of ٱلْعَقَبَةَ tracks vegetation hardening toward dryness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pass can be an ecological threshold: drying land forces movement across a harsh boundary. The negated entry then evokes failure to face a crisis that displaces bodies rather than a voluntary feat of mountaineering.

activation_trace.role: The barren year that drives desert people into settled land supplies compelled crisis-movement.
Plant yellowing and approaching dryness supplies the environmental pressure behind that movement.
The difficult pass keeps the ecological transition anchored in the focus noun's terrain.

changed_reading.before: The pass is a stable mountain obstacle chosen by an individual.
changed_reading.after: The pass may also be a drought-made threshold that forces vulnerable movement; refusing it means declining encounter with displacement and scarcity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A branch internal to ٱقْتَحَمَ concerns the eye under- or over-sizing a thing, and ٱلْعَقَبَةَ supplies the thing whose scale must be judged.
baseline_models.mechanism: Non-entry may arise from distorted valuation rather than absent strength. The pass is mis-sized by the observer, so apparent magnitude and actual demand come apart.

activation_trace.role: The eye's under- or over-estimation makes faulty appraisal an internal cause of non-entry.
The visibly steep pass is the demand whose apparent and effective scale can diverge.
Outcome supplies the less visible measure by which the pass should be valued.

changed_reading.before: He sees a hard obstacle and fails to cross it.
changed_reading.after: His failure may begin in seeing wrongly: he mistakes visible size for the pass's true, outcome-bearing cost.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding bounded place and the loosening of a knot or prohibition activate a threshold reading: the pass stands where settled enclosure and released movement meet.

activation_trace.role: Forceful entry supplies movement across the activated boundary.
The raised pass materializes the boundary as a resistant threshold.
A delimited tract of land supplies the enclosed side of the threshold.
Untying a knot makes passage a release from constriction rather than mere travel.
The lifting of a prohibition adds a legal opening to the spatial boundary.

structural_cues: The same city noun encloses 90:1-2 before the focus introduces motion.
A state of being حِلّ in the city precedes the negated act of entering the pass.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded land, untying, and released prohibition; I supply the arrow from those states to a civic or legal threshold in ٱلْعَقَبَةَ. A live alternative is that the city frame remains locative and does not redefine the pass.

changed_reading.before: The pass is a freestanding obstacle outside any social boundary.
changed_reading.after: The pass can mark departure from protected enclosure into released but costly obligation; he remains on the bounded side.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation in hardship makes the pass a concentrated interior of the human condition rather than an accidental external interruption. Its ascent is the exposed center of what human life already entails.

activation_trace.role: Entry into severity supplies the act by which one accepts rather than evades the condition.
The steep pass gives constitutive hardship a localized ridge to be entered.
Fitness or preparedness for a thing makes hardship a capacity-bearing condition, not proof of incapacity.
Hardship and enduring struggle directly amplify the pass's severity.
The middle or heart relocates the difficult pass from life's margin to its center.

structural_cues: 90:4 predicates كَبَد of the created human before 90:11 negates entry into the pass.
The focus therefore follows an assertion of hardship as already constitutive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, preparedness, hardship, and centrality; I infer that the pass concentrates this condition and that non-entry is evasion rather than inability. The alternative is that 90:4 only supplies a general background of difficulty.

changed_reading.before: He encounters an exceptional hardship external to ordinary human life.
changed_reading.after: He refuses the concentrated center of a hardship for which human life is already constituted and capacitated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supposition, declared expenditure, piled quantity, and visibility turn the focus into an audit of valuation. Countable, speakable loss is mistaken for crossing, while the pass is measured by its effective outcome.

activation_trace.role: The eye's mis-sizing supplies the appraisal error joining visible outlay to non-entry.
Outcome supplies the hidden measure that mere quantity fails to satisfy.
Supposition makes the mistaken self-assessment explicit.
Audible assertion turns expenditure into a self-narrated credential.
Exhausting or consuming effort supplies real cost without yet proving effective passage.
Quantity piled layer on layer supplies the impressive visible metric that can be overvalued.
Public-facing display keeps open the possibility that the claimed cost is calibrated to observers.
Direct witnessing sharpens the irony that having sight does not ensure correct valuation.

structural_cues: The repeated أَيَحْسَبُ surrounds a boast about destroying piled wealth.
Seeing and the gift of two eyes immediately precede guidance and the focus failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, spoken cost, piled quantity, seeing, and the focus branch of visual mis-sizing; I infer that the boast substitutes visible expenditure for outcome-bearing action. It remains possible that the expenditure was simply wrongful rather than performatively mismeasured.

changed_reading.before: He failed because he did not spend or exert enough.
changed_reading.after: He may have spent greatly yet still not crossed: declared quantity is mis-sized as achievement when no liberating or sustaining outcome follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance indicates elevated routes but does not carry the traveler. The focus branch of unled desert-going activates the moment when shown direction must become self-propelled entry.

activation_trace.role: Going through open desert without a driver supplies self-propelled movement after external indication ends.
The steep pass is the resistant segment the traveler must personally enter.
Gentle indication toward a path supplies orientation without forced transport.
Elevation makes the two indicated routes topographically continuous with the pass.
Proceeding in a need converts visible route into purposeful motion.

structural_cues: Guidance to the dual uplands occurs immediately before فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ.
The shift is from a supplied plural route to a negated singular act of entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle path-indication, elevation, purposeful proceeding, and unled travel; I infer a handoff from guidance to agency. The alternative is that the two uplands are moral options and the unled-desert image is only a distant resonance.

changed_reading.before: He does not cross because no route has been available.
changed_reading.after: The route has been indicated; the failure is not informational but kinetic—he does not turn guidance into his own launch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate question about knowing the repeated noun activates its follow-up and review branch. The text itself reopens the apparently obvious mountain image, postponing the pass's operative identity until subsequent disclosures.

activation_trace.role: Following up to question or challenge makes the focus noun internally available for revision.
The steep pass remains the literal substrate whose sufficiency is being challenged.
Knowledge and discernment make the pass something whose identity must be learned.
The repeated noun performs the lexical follow-up that reopens its first reading.

structural_cues: 90:12 repeats ٱلْعَقَبَةُ exactly and places it inside a ما ... ما interrogative frame.
The question intervenes before any concrete acts are named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition, inquiry, knowledge, and follow-up/challenge; I infer that the question suspends the sufficiency of the obvious topographic gloss. The literal pass remains live rather than being canceled.

changed_reading.before: The audience already knows that the pass is simply steep terrain.
changed_reading.after: The clause names a pass whose functional identity is deliberately unresolved and must be recognized through what follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first disclosed act reverses the material logic of an obstacle: tough sinew binds, while فك opens what is closed and releases a neck. The pass is crossed by undoing another's constriction, not by elevating oneself over it.

activation_trace.role: Entering severity assigns cost and exposure to the one who undertakes the release.
Tough sinew used for binding recasts the obstacle as constriction holding parts or persons together.
Opening the closed and separating the entangled supplies the pass-crossing operation.
Releasing a pledge or captive neck makes the opening socially directional toward another's freedom.
The neck gives the entanglement an embodied human locus.

structural_cues: The terse nominal phrase فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ immediately follows the question defining the pass.
The sequence moves from failed entry to an act of opening and release.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding sinew, opening, release from pledge or captivity, and a neck; I infer that liberating another is the mechanism of crossing. The live alternative is that release is one example on the far side of a still primarily topographic metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Crossing means forcing one's own body over resistant height.
changed_reading.after: Crossing means accepting severe entry in order to loosen what binds another body; ascent is achieved through release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's drought-driven entry is activated by feeding during a famine-day. The crosser does not escape the scarcity zone but enters its pressure and moves sustenance toward those whom drought and exhaustion expose.

activation_trace.role: A barren year forcing migration supplies the displaced population and crisis movement.
Vegetation yellowing toward dryness supplies the ecological onset of scarcity.
Feeding another directs the crosser's movement toward relief rather than self-preservation.
The day's calamitous severity concentrates the act in an emergency interval.
Hunger joined to exhaustion supplies the bodily consequence of the drought threshold.

structural_cues: 90:14 locates other-directed feeding inside a day characterized by مَسْغَبَة.
The act follows the reopened definition of ٱلْعَقَبَةَ rather than appearing as an independent theme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies drought-forced movement, drying plants, feeding, temporal severity, and exhausted hunger; I infer that crossing entails entering another's scarcity and reversing its flow with food. The alternative is a looser analogy between two kinds of hardship.

changed_reading.before: The traveler heroically escapes a barren and dangerous pass.
changed_reading.after: The crosser enters the famine-pressure that drives others and carries sustenance into it; the failed crossing is a failure of solidarity with displaced hunger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The steep upward image is socially inverted by nearness, severed support, immobilization, and dust-clinging poverty. The actual route goes toward the nearby and downward to the ground-bound; ascent is measured by abolished social distance.

activation_trace.role: Costly entry keeps approach from becoming effortless sentiment.
The rising pass supplies the vertical image that the social movement reverses.
A child cut off from a sustaining guardian supplies relational severance as the obstacle.
Nearness turns the route from distant heroism toward an immediately reachable claimant.
Kinship makes proximity a binding social relation rather than mere geometry.
Loss of movement supplies the immobilized person whom the crosser must approach.
Poverty pictured as clinging to dust pulls the elevated pass down to ground level.

structural_cues: The recipients are grammatically brought near after the pass is questioned and exemplified.
The sequence moves from an elevated obstacle to a person described through contact with the ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed guardianship, kin-nearness, immobility, dust-poverty, and a steep focus pass; I infer a deliberate inversion in which ethical ascent requires moving down and near. The alternative is that these are beneficiaries without a spatial reversal.

changed_reading.before: The pass calls for upward separation from ordinary social space.
changed_reading.after: Its route runs toward nearby dependence and down to the dust-bound poor; the height is crossed by closing social distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sudden plunge image is stretched into succession and repeated return. Mutual counsel, restraint, mercy, and companionship make crossing a relay sustained among people rather than a solitary punctiliar feat.

activation_trace.role: The abrupt entry into severity supplies the initiating moment that later duration must sustain.
One thing following and replacing another supplies the relay's succession.
Return to an act after a like act supplies recurrence beyond a single crossing.
Mutual exchange of counsel makes endurance and mercy circulate among participants.
Holding the self against panic supplies duration under the pass's pressure.
Bearing liability and remaining with it turns commitment into sustained accompaniment.
Tender mercy prevents endurance from hardening into merely self-regarding toughness.
Companionship and abiding together give the relay a durable social body.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ extends the sequence after release and feeding.
تَوَاصَوْا is repeated with patience and mercy before a collective أصحاب designation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, repeated return, reciprocal counsel, restraint, mercy, and companionship; I infer that these convert a moment of entry into a renewable communal practice. The alternative is that they are subsequent qualifications rather than part of crossing itself.

changed_reading.before: Crossing is one person's brief heroic burst through danger.
changed_reading.after: Entry begins a repeated social relay: people keep one another moving through severity by counsel, restraint, mercy, and companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window develops an open/closed architecture. The pass is disclosed through opening a bond, while covering signs and sealed fire form the terminal inverse; refusal to cross participates in a movement from avoided opening to enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Entering peril supplies the opening movement that the negated subject avoids.
Outcome licenses reading the later enclosure as an aftermath of refused passage.
Opening what is closed establishes the positive pole of the sequence.
Covering supplies a perceptual and volitional closure before the final physical seal.
Kindled fire supplies the dangerous content enclosed at the sequence's endpoint.
The non-dominant mapped branch of a door clamped shut supplies the terminal enclosure.

structural_cues: فَكُّ opens the post-focus disclosures, while مُّؤْصَدَة closes the surah window.
Those who cover the signs intervene between liberating acts and sealed fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, covering, fire, sealing, and the focus branch of outcome; I supply the directional arrow from refused opening to terminal enclosure. A live alternative is that the final closure is judgment imagery without a designed material reversal of فك.

changed_reading.before: The failed pass is an isolated missed ascent.
changed_reading.after: It is a hinge in an open/closed sequence: he declines costly opening, and the window culminates in a closure imposed over its occupants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads terrain through a commercial-legal branch, not because it replaces the ordinary steep-pass sense. It remains anchored in the focus noun's retained-liability branch and is independently activated by release from pledge or captivity in 90:13. Downstream prose should present it as a legal overlay: crossing resembles clearing a claim that keeps a person bound.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْعَقَبَةَ can denote substitution, follow-up claim, or retained liability, while the focus verb enters unwanted consequences.

activation_trace.role: Entering unwanted consequences supplies acceptance of the costly claim rather than its evasion.
Substitution and retained liability make the pass resemble an unresolved lien or follow-up claim.
Releasing a pledge or captive activates discharge of the retained claim.
The neck identifies the human being whose bondage the legal discharge changes.

changed_reading.before: He did not climb over an external obstruction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he did not clear the retained claim that keeps a neck bound; the pass is crossed by assuming and discharging liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates decrepitude and posterity rather than the focus words' common motion senses. It remains valid as an exact focus-branch constellation sharpened by parent, offspring, orphanhood, womb, and kinship across the window. Downstream prose should call it an exploratory life-cycle resonance, not a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A branch of ٱقْتَحَمَ names an aged person sunk into decrepitude, and a branch of ٱلْعَقَبَةَ names posterity left after.

activation_trace.role: Old age and decrepitude supply dependence at one end of the life course.
Posterity left after supplies intergenerational continuity and obligation.
Offspring from a lineage establishes the generational beginning of the activated arc.
A child cut off from a guardian exposes a break in intergenerational care.
The womb supplies embodied origin and makes mercy resonate with generative dependence.

changed_reading.before: The pass tests an autonomous adult at one heroic moment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is the burden of carrying care across birth, orphaned rupture, posterity, and decrepitude rather than abandoning dependent life stages.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ه د د target carried by the packet's split mapping for ه د ي. It remains anchored by the exact difficult-descent branch, the two elevated routes, and the focus's steep pass. Downstream prose must identify it as split-root topological activation and must not claim that the surface هَدَيْ directly means descent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines forceful entry with a steep pass, a shape capable of joining ascent to a far-side descent.

activation_trace.role: Plunging into severity supplies movement over and beyond a ridge rather than only upward toward it.
The steep pass and jutting ledge supply the ridge or saddle.
The non-dominant split target's arduous descent supplies the far side of the pass.
The two elevations supply the high terrain between which the saddle reading operates.

changed_reading.before: The obstacle is a one-directional climb ending at a peak.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pass is a ridge transition with both ascent and arduous descent; crossing means accepting the unseen far side, not merely reaching height.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from generic hard ascent to a pass whose obvious definition is explicitly reopened by the next ayah.
Binding sinew plus فكّ رقبة changed crossing into costly unbinding of another person.
The drought-year branch, famine-day, and feeding produced a live ecological-solidarity reading.
Near kin, severed guardianship, immobility, and dust-poverty inverted vertical ascent into movement down and near.
Succession, repeated return, mutual counsel, patience, mercy, and companionship stretched a sudden plunge into a durable social relay.
Mis-sizing, counted expenditure, public speech, and seeing distinguished impressive cost from outcome-bearing passage.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots did not settle into one metaphor. Their branch inventory let the same negated entry coexist as hazardous ascent, recoil threshold, misvaluation, accountable aftermath, drought displacement, material unbinding, social proximity, and repeated communal practice; split mappings also preserved a contained ridge-and-descent topology.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact rhetorical force of فَلَا remains capable of coloring failure, refusal, or reproach differently without eliminating the retained mechanisms.
The civic-boundary, legal-lien, ecological, and life-cycle models may be resonant overlays rather than equal semantic centers.
The non-dominant ه د د descent activation is packet-licensed but must remain explicitly distinct from a direct lexical gloss of هَدَيْ.
The final opening-to-sealing relation is an inferred directional arc; the packet supplies the endpoints but not an explicit causal connective.
